title: Stampede
logline: Dawn in a sleeping city. A six storey {{product.name}} drops into the plaza fountain, and a giant spectacle made from its own look charges off it down the avenue, switching the whole city on as it runs.

ingested: a giant beverage or snack pack dripping in a fountain is classic fake out of home
applied: giant tubes and jars are the most proven FOOH subject; a glossy ribbon of the texture makes a strong spectacle
worn: a building-sized shoe, bag-like accessory or draped garment in a plaza reads instantly; the runner wears the real one at the end
handheld: a six storey device powering on, with light rings as the spectacle
carried: a giant bag standing in the fountain and springing open works; soft bags need to be shown upright
home: a sofa, lamp or appliance spanning the fountain basin is a strong stunt; the runner rests a hand on a normal-size one at the end instead of holding it
consumable: the giant pack works; the spectacle from the rule (a river of the contents, never the pack) carries it

avoid: weapons, blades or anything that reads as a threat at building scale
products whose only visual is a person or mascot character (the rule falls back to material or colour, which weakens the stunt)

lore: Calloway is a fictional harbour city of 1.4 million on a cold northern bay. Founders' Plaza sits at the top of Ferris Avenue, a dead-straight 2 km run down to the ferry piers.
The Founders' Fountain was carved in 1911 from grey granite: a round basin 30 metres across with four bronze dolphin spouts, green with verdigris, restored last spring.
It is 6:04am on a Tuesday in late October. The first Harbor Line tram of the day leaves the plaza at 6:10; the street sweeper has just passed and the paving is still wet.
Jae Park runs the same 8 km loop at this hour every weekday, plaza to piers and back, and has never once seen the city switch on before him.
Kettle & Oar, the corner cafe on the plaza, opens at 6:30; its chairs are still stacked and chained under the striped awning.

hero_spectacle.why: The board's giant animals came from the example product's own logo. The template keeps the idea (the product releases a giant living force that switches the city on) but derives that force from each product's own visual, so it always belongs to the brand in the ad and never borrows anyone else's.
derivation_rule: 1. Logo or label motif first: if the product's mark or label art contains a simple figurative symbol (an animal, bird, leaf, flower, flame, wave, star, sun, crown, drop), the spectacle is two giant photoreal versions of that symbol, sculpted as glossy solid forms or living creatures in the motif's own colour, three storeys tall, moving the way that thing moves (animals run, birds skim low over the street, leaves and petals glide, waves roll, stars and drops bound).

2. Shape or material second: if the mark is only lettering or an abstract shape, or the motif is a person, a mascot character or a predator that would read as a threat in a city (shark, snake, spider), the spectacle is one giant continuous surge made of the product's own material in its strongest colour: a rolling glossy wave of the liquid for beverages, a thick glossy ribbon of the cream, gel or powder for applied products, a streaming banner of the fabric, leather or mesh for worn products, rings of light pulsing out from the lights, screen or edges of a device, a streaming ribbon of the strap and body material for bags, a rolling wave of the upholstery, glass or light for home products, a tumbling river of the contents (never the pack) for consumables.
3. Colour last: if neither gives a clear form, the spectacle is a surging wall of light and haze in the product's strongest colour, three storeys high, rolling along the street.
constants: never letters, never a copy of the wordmark, never a second giant product
always a separate object from the product; the product's printed label stays untouched and exactly as the reference
always emerges from a burst of light in the product's accent colour at the product's base, in S05
three storeys tall (half the product's height), the only saturated colour in the cool blue city apart from the product
always runs from the plaza down the avenue to the harbour, switching on windows, streetlights and the tram in its wake, then leaps or surges into the sunrise and dissolves into light of its colour
creatures keep every leg on the ground or mid stride, move forward only, normal gravity; surges hug the street surface and flow forward only
tone is wonder: nobody harmed or panicking, nothing smashed except cracked paving on the first step
hero_spectacle.fill: Before Stage 4, write one sentence `spectacle` (form, colour, surface, motion) from the rule, and one short `spectacle_sound`. Replace every [spectacle] marker in shots, units and actions with that sentence (or a short form of it after its first use in a prompt). Render a spectacle reference sheet from `sheet_prompt` and pass it as the `spectacle` reference wherever refs list it.
hero_spectacle.sheet_prompt: Photoreal computer-generated reference sheet on a plain mid-grey background, side view and three-quarter front view of the same form: [spectacle]. Glossy like wet lacquer with sharp white specular highlights, vivid saturated colour, not brown or muddy. A real physical form, not a logo, not a drawing. No letters, no logos.
hero_spectacle.sound: the spectacle's own physical sound, set in the fill: hooves or footfalls on granite for creatures, a rushing liquid roar for a wave, a deep fabric snap for a banner, a rising electric hum for light rings

beats.summary: A sleeping city at dawn. Something enormous falls out of the sky and lands in the plaza fountain with a boom.
One early runner stops dead, earbud out, and looks up at it.
The reveal orbit: the giant product, label square to camera. Then the hero spectacle, built from the product's own logo motif, material or colour, emerges from a burst of light at its base.
The spectacle surges down the avenue. Every streetlight, window and tram lights up in its wake; the runner sprints beside it, laughing.
At the waterfront the spectacle leaps into the rising sun and the whole skyline is switched on.
The giant product stands in the now busy plaza; the runner has a normal-size one at its base. Brand line, tagline, blank billboard filled in post.

units.prompt: 9:16 photoreal fake out of home CGI, dawn in a North American city plaza, cool blue grade, handheld street footage feel, upright frame with level horizon. Shot 1 (0 to 1.8 s): street level looking up past pigeons, {{action.S01}}, the product exactly as @Image1, toward the fountain of @Image2. Shot 2 (1.8 to 3.6 s): {{action.S02}}, a crown of water explodes outward, pigeons burst into the air, 4 frames of camera shake. Shot 3 (3.6 to 6 s): slow push-in on @Image3 (Jae), a runner who stops dead, pulls out an earbud and stares up as mist drifts past. The product never dents, tilts or changes. Native sound: city hush, rising air whistle, sub boom, water crash, window glass rattle, pigeon wings, runner's breath. No speech. No music. All signs blank, no text.

9:16 photoreal CGI hero. Shot 1 (0 to 3 s): low angle, slow 20 degree orbit around {{action.S04}}, the product exactly as @Image1, label square to camera and undistorted, golden rim light. Shot 2 (3 to 6 s): {{action.S05}}; out of the light [spectacle] from @Image2, three storeys tall, emerges onto the plaza, cracking the stone on its first step, steam in the cold air, turning to face the avenue. The product's printed label stays intact; the product does not move or change. Native sound: the product settling, heavy drips on water, low rumble, cracking stone, the spectacle's own sound. No speech. No music. No text.

9:16 photoreal CGI chase at dawn, upright frame, level horizon. Shot 1 (0 to 3.5 s): low head-on, [spectacle] from @Image3 surges toward camera down the avenue of @Image1, streetlights and shop windows switching on warm as it passes. Shot 2 (3.5 to 6.5 s): drone top-down moving with it, a wave of light spreading through the towers behind it, a plain silver tram lights up. Shot 3 (6.5 to 9.5 s): tracking beside it, @Image2 (Jae) sprints on the pavement next to its leading edge, laughing, same direction of travel. Shot 4 (9.5 to 14 s): extreme wide from behind, the spectacle leaps or surges off the end of a harbour pier into a huge rising sun and dissolves into light of its own colour while the whole skyline is now lit. It moves forward only, normal gravity, no extra legs. Native sound: the spectacle thundering on the street, streetlights buzzing on, wind, tram bell, a laugh, whoosh, gulls. No speech. No music. All signs blank, no text.

9:16 photoreal CGI pack shot, bright morning. Slow push-in then hold on the plaza of @Image3: the giant product exactly as @Image1, scaled up in the fountain, label square to camera, commuters walking around its base; in the foreground @Image2 (Jae), {{action.S10}}, grinning up at the giant one. A blank white billboard on the tower stays empty. Neither product moves or changes. Native sound: busy morning plaza, fountain water, footsteps, a tram bell. No speech. No music. No text.

music.brief: Near silence, one high sustained string note rising with the falling product, cut to nothing on the impact so the boom lands in silence, then a single low piano note.
Slow brass swell in C minor under the orbit, taiko hits on each step or bound as the spectacle emerges.
Driving 128 bpm trailer percussion with galloping 6/8 toms, brass ostinato, lifting a step at the drone shot, peak at the leap into the sun.
Resolves to C major, bright brass chord and a light shaker, ring out past the last frame under the VO.

sfx.sound: sub boom and water crash of the landing
sfx.why: the hook lives on this hit; reinforce if the native boom is thin

sfx.sound: the spectacle's first impact on stone (a hoof, a bound or a wave crash, per the fill)
sfx.why: sells the spectacle as physical and marks the product turning into energy

voices.speaker: vo
voices.plan: one deep warm male narrator recorded as a single TTS track in post over all units (units are generated with no speech); the brand line uses product.phonetic and lands over the short exact risk unit U4

captions.active_word: #FFD23F (sun gold) on the word being spoken
captions.position: centre, 74% down the frame, clear of the product and above platform UI
captions.motion: each word punches in at 115% and settles to 100% over 4 frames, timed to the VO

post_text.style: Archivo Black white, set into the blank billboard on the tower with perspective match and a slight bloom, fades up 8 frames at 25.0 s; the sub (product.tagline when the page has one, else the L5 line) slides up under it at 27.8 s

qa: where an action offers choices in parentheses (a beverage or food, footwear or a garment, large or small pieces), keep only the one that fits this product and delete the rest before prompting
the spectacle follows world_bible.hero_spectacle: derived from this product's own motif, material or colour, never lettering, never a second giant product
no [spectacle] marker remains in any prompt; the spectacle sheet was rendered and passed as a reference in S05 to S09
the giant product keeps its exact label in S01 to S05 and S10, one single giant product, never dented or tilted
scale is stated and consistent: six storeys for hand and body products, spanning the fountain basin for room products
the spectacle never covers or wipes the product's printed label in S05
every sign and billboard blank; the billboard text is added in post
L3 and L4 benefits are verbatim from product.benefits and are two different benefits

actions.S02: {{product.visual}}, six storeys tall, just landed perfectly upright in the centre of the round fountain, intact, label square to camera
actions.S03: {{product.visual}} standing six storeys tall and upright in the fountain, label facing camera, recognisable
actions.S04: {{product.visual}}, scaled up six storeys tall, upright in the fountain, label square to camera, condensation droplets as large as cars rolling down its side and falling into the water
actions.S05: {{product.visual}}, six storeys tall and upright in the fountain, its top opening with a puff of cold mist (a beverage) or its wrapper peeling back (food) as a burst of light in its accent colour flares at its base
actions.S10: holding the same product at normal size, {{product.visual}}, at chest height with its label facing camera
